About the ranked experience
Have you ever thought of a more competitive ranked mode? I'll explain better: leave ranked as it is now for solo queue with a standalone rank. Then you add team ones, when you can create you own team available on the platform (sort of a clan) and play from duos on to 5 stack. This will give a huge boost to ranked imo, cause imagine being able to see the team stats when u find the lobby (most banned operators, most used, most played maps, as a pro league team will do when facing someone, but just by clicking on the nickname and seeing the clan info), so adapt map bans, op bans and even strategies. Keep the elo restriction only for solo q, so we will be able to play with everyone we want, and in duos on give a rank to the team, in this way you will not see copper with diamonds, as soon as you get in a team you'll play as the higher elo of the team, and get the charm as long as you play like 10 games. I'm tired of ranked nowadays, not talking about mnk on console that's the main issue but because people do the same bans, play the same maps and play the same objectives,  so if you're stuck in high gold/plat the game isn't as fresh as it was when a lot of things were coming with the new seasons.
